chunks: No one preceded me in inviting people to truthfulness, in giving consideration to kinship and practising generosity.

So, hear my word and preserve what I say. Maybe you will see soon after today that over this matter swords will be drawn and pledges will be broken, so much so that some of you will become leaders of the people of misguidance and followers of people of ignorance.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali predict about the future leadership and social state after his time?
ai.summary: Delivered during the Saqifa incident following Umar ibn al-Khattab's death, this narration underscores Imam Ali’s (AS) claim to precedence in da'wah and his warning against the political fragmentation that would follow. He predicts the rise of 'Shi'a of Ignorance' (Shi'at al-Jahiliyyah), a key concept in Shia historiography denoting those who deviated from the true path of leadership, thereby setting the stage for the subsequent era of caliphal rule and conflict.
